business_summary: Sichuan Development Lomon Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of phosphorus chemical products in China. The company offers phosphorus chemical products, including industrial-grade monoammonium phosphate, fertilizer-grade monoammonium phosphate, feed-grade dicalcium phosphate, and various compound fertilizers as well as lithium iron phosphate. It also engages in agricultural; logistics and transportation; loading and unloading, handling, warehousing activities; phosphate production and sale; research and development, and production of new materials; phosphate mining, washing, and sale activities; pipeline transportation; engineering design, supervision, and construction businesses; manufacture of chemical raw materials and chemical products; and iron ore mining and washing business. The company was formerly known as Chengdu Santai Holding Group Co., Ltd. Sichuan Development Lomon Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
business_summary_ko: 사천개발로몬(주) 중국에서 인계 화학제품의 연구개발, 생산, 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 공업용 인산일암모늄, 비료급 인산일암모늄, 사료급 인산이칼슘, 각종 복합비료, 인산철리튬 등 인산 화학 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 농업에도 종사하고 있습니다. 물류 및 운송; 선적 및 하역, 취급, 창고 보관 활동; 인산염 생산 및 판매; 연구개발, 신소재 생산; 인산염 채굴, 세척 및 판매 활동; 파이프라인 운송; 엔지니어링 설계, 감리, 건설업; 화학 원료 및 화학 제품의 제조; 철광석 채굴 및 세척 사업. 회사의 이전 명칭은 Chengdu Santai Holding Group Co., Ltd. Sichuan Development Lomon Co.,Ltd. 1997년에 설립되었으며 중국 청두에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
